_source.repo: https://github.com/johanneswieland/RomerShocks (linked as 'Updated Romer-Romer Monetary shocks' from https://johanneswieland.github.io; the README says a stable version is on openICPSR, project 135741)
_source.citation: Wieland, J. F. and Yang, M.-J. (2020), 'Financial Dampening', Journal of Money, Credit and Banking; with Romer, C. D. and Romer, D. H. (2004), 'A New Measure of Monetary Shocks: Derivation and Implications', AER.
_source.variables: date; resid = original Romer-Romer (2004) shocks (ends 1996); resid_romer = shocks from the original R&R regression (estimated on the R&R sample) applied to 1969-2007; resid_full = shocks from the R&R regression re-estimated on 1969-2007
_source.aggregation: per RR_monetary_shock_update.do: meeting shocks summed to months, quarters and years (collapse (sum)); months with no meeting = 0
_source.method: fetched with curl in the cloud sandbox from raw.githubusercontent.com at the pinned commit; SHA-256 independently re-computed in the built-in browser on the same URLs (all three .txt match); written into the repo byte-for-byte

RR_monetary_shock_update.do.note: Wieland's Stata code that builds the three series
